title: Quenched Indian Rice Biryani
description: A fresh, light Gujarati-style biryani with char-grilled vegetables, unwaxed lemon zest, and cooked in a traditional dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice until the water runs clear and soak for 20 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a dolsot stone bowl and add cumin, cardamom, cloves, and cinnamon, sautéing until aromatic.
Add sliced onions, garlic paste, ginger paste, and green chili; cook until onions are golden.
Stir in tomato puree and cook for 3 minutes, then add the soaked rice and gently fold to coat the grains.
Pour in water, season with salt, and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover with the dolsot lid.
Cook for 15 minutes until the rice is tender and the steam escapes, then remove the lid and fluff with a fork.
Sprinkle fresh lemon zest, lemon juice, coriander, and mint over the rice, stirring to combine.
Transfer the biryani to a serving dish, drizzle ghee on top, and let it rest for 5 minutes to set the flavors.
Serve warm, optionally with a side of cucumber raita or a fresh salad.
